title: research_spec.ready (v1)
description: ProblemModelingAgent has finished the ClarifyingResearchGoal dialogue and frozen a ResearchSpec into the Research Store. ResearchOrchestrator uses this to transition ClarifyingResearchGoal -> DeepResearching (state machine V1.10 §1). Payload is intentionally minimal: the ResearchSpec itself (see agents/problem_modeling_agent/data-contracts/research_spec.schema.yaml) is read from the Research Store by ref.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.
